purpose: Qualify live Hermes semantic intake behavior against the merged request-intake corpus without creating a generic evaluation subsystem.

hard_failures: Hermes emits K/V/C as its own authority
Hermes emits PROCEED/CONSULT/GATE as its own decision
live run reuses prior session state
exact runtime/model/instruction identity is not recorded
review_focus: whether ambiguity is preserved instead of guessed
whether coordination is emitted only when materially supported

execution_blocker.missing_prerequisite: An exact observed Hermes 0.21.3 runtime/profile that can run the corpus case-by-case with the merged pantheon-request-intake instruction snapshot while recording runtime/model identity and isolated raw outputs.
execution_blocker.why_repo_tests_are_insufficient: Repository tests validate the corpus, vocabulary ownership and deterministic Pantheon projection, but cannot establish whether a live language model infers the intended conditions with acceptable false-positive and false-negative behavior.
execution_blocker.allowed_next_step: Run the referenced corpus against the exact selected Hermes runtime/profile, store the raw outputs as evaluation observations outside governed truth, score the declared measures, and submit the result for human review before operational qualification.
execution_blocker.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat this pilot, green CI, a deterministic fake provider or the presence of the SKILL.md as proof that live semantic intake is qualified.
